description: GTFS-Datensatz VRS is a dataset listed in German national open data portal (GovData), an open data portal, published or maintained by Mobilithek. Vollständiger Datensatz von Soll-Fahrplandaten im GTFS-Format.Das abgedeckte Gebiet umfasst das Gebiet von go.Rheinland, schließt also Köln, Aachen und Bonn, sowie die zugehörigen Regionen mit ein.Der Datensatz wird nahezu täglich aktualisiert. Coverage: Mobilithek. The portal files it under the publisher Mobilithek. Its tags are gtfs, opendata-öpnv, soll-fahrplandaten, zip. It offers 27 resource(s) in HTTP://PUBLICATIONS.EUROPA.EU/RESOURCE/AUTHORITY/FILE-TYPE/ZIP. The portal shows 2026-09-25 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support public transport network, service and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-de-portal.
